rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Dynamic REST API gateway that uses ZML (Zero-cost Module Language), a custom declarative configuration language, to define API endpoints and data structures without code changes. The Rust-based implementation features a ZML parser and compiler that converts configuration files into JSON schemas, supporting type definitions, enums, HTTP methods, rate limiting, and multiple authentication strategies including token-based and login-based flows. Provides both stdio and HTTP transport modes with real-time web-based configuration management, preset system for different deployment scenarios, and dynamic module loading for rapid API integration.
